item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 02/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be slightly cooler over the coast of Guangdong this morning. With the monsoon moderating gradually in the next couple of days, temperatures will rise slightly over Guangdong. Another dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will become brighter over the region. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas.
